title: finding(types): `ObjectChartSchema.series` (TS and zod) copies the renderer's `dataKey` arm without the per-series `type` that arm declares since objectui#8086, while the zod `.describe` still calls it "the arm ChartRendererProps declares"
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ a trap (class c): a published copy that lags the declaration it names as its source. An `object-chart` author who writes a per-series `type` gets a TS excess-property error, and the zod face drops the key, while the renderer honours it on every other path. Reader: triage first; it may need a `Clause-②` decision.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#8086 dev report and contract review (PR objectui#10554). Recorded on ACCEPT `5829727125`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Fact (read by the seat on `origin/main` at `90dbd1d31`)

- `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.tsx:~75`: both arms of `ChartRendererProps.schema.series` carry `type?: string` (objectui#8086, pinned in `ChartRenderer.seriesTypeArm-8086.test.ts`).
- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts:~4383`: `ObjectChartSchema.series` is the `dataKey` arm WITHOUT `type`. Its docblock (~:4375) is already honest about it: "every member of it except `type`, which that arm gained under objectui#8086 and this copy has not taken up".
- `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:~2456`: the zod copy has no `type` either, and its `.describe` reads "the arm ChartRendererProps declares". That is no longer true member for member.

## The question for triage

Should the published `ObjectChartSchema` copy take up `type`? The alternative is to keep the copy deliberately narrower and correct the `.describe`.
- Taking it up widens a published accept set: `Clause-②: yes`, `minor`.
- Keeping it narrower is a prose fix, but it leaves the per-series family override unauthorable on `object-chart` while `chart` accepts it.

Recorded beside this, not part of it: the series union has no literal discriminant, so `{ name, chartType }` passes at the TS union level while the zod face refuses `chartType` by name. That is a React prop type, not stored metadata.

⚠️ Serial: this seat's objectui#10518 (`ObjectChartSchema` `xAxis` / `yAxis`, in flight) edits the same two files.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18T15:37Z): `ObjectChartSchema` within 300 characters of `series` ⇒ 2 hits, the seat post and PR objectui#10554 (the origin). `seriesTypeArm` ⇒ 1 hit, PR objectui#10554.
